caveats: Archived256request C64 profile, not matched1088 work or noninstrumentedperformance.
Context annotation counts scheduled codec jobs; actual graph input batches/frame buckets are not exposed by the trace and are NOT inferred.
GraphGPUspan from all kernels sharing runtime launch correlation; includes intervening waits/contention and is not the sum of kernel durations.
Do not count empty polling contexts or graph/kernel events as extra scheduler steps.
Simple average scheduled jobs/graphlaunch assumes normal valid nonempty streamed jobs; do not interpret it as capacity, padding, or same-workcomparison.
